title: A Detention for the Mixtape
author: Sable Kavanagh
blurb: Freya Amberdale, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
